testimonials.author: Parents of Syed Hasan Ahmed
testimonials.content: Respected School Management, Assalam o Alaikum. I would like to sincerely appreciate the entire management, staff, and everyone involved in organizing today’s event. The event was very well managed, and it was wonderful to see how much care and attention was given to all the children. The children truly enjoyed themselves. My son was not feeling well today, but I gave him medicine and sent him to school because he was very excited about the event. Despite not being well, he enjoyed it so much. However, towards the end of the event, his health started to deteriorate. I received a call from the Junior Coordinator, Miss Fatima Afzal. As soon as I received the call, I rushed to the school. What touched me the most was that until I reached the school, Miss Fatima Zohra stayed beside my son, continuously looking after him and making sure he was comfortable and okay. As soon as I reached the school, Miss Fatima Afzal immediately coordinated everything and handed my child over to me without any delay. The way she understood that my child was getting unwell and responded so promptly was truly appreciated. Miss Fatima Zohra and Miss Fatima Afzal also took great care of my son and showed genuine concern and compassion towards him. As a parent, this means a lot to me.
testimonials.title: Parents of Syed Hasan Ahmed

testimonials.author: Maham Siddiqui
testimonials.relationship: Parent of Syed Moosa Bukhari & Syed Abdullah Bukhari
testimonials.content:
Respected Authorities,

Assalamoalekum wa rehmat ullahi wa barakatuhu

I, mother of Syed Moosa Bukhari and Syed Abdullah Bukhari, would like to pour my heart on today's event of Hifz Ceremony Batch 2023-24.

It would going to be a long email, so kindly bear it with me 🙂

Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Alameen.. all praise to Allah Subhana wa taala who makes the impossible, possible.. Who seals the Holy Quran in the hearts of such young Muslims.. Who blessed us to witness this day.. Alhamdulillah summa alhamdulillah..

Today, it was a blessing to see all those young Huffaz and Hafizat mashaAllah.. May Allah protects them from evil eye.

First of all, I would like to mention the highlight of the day, which was “THE LAST SABAQ”. I cannot describe in words what I felt during those 6 minutes.. I have never experienced such an emotional indescribable feeling.. Never ever in my life.. It's like reliving all the emotions and moments of the whole HIFZ journey during those 6 minutes.. The most emotional moments of my life.. I was having goosebumps, shivers and an indescribable rush of emotions such that my heart wanted to cry out loud... Alhamdulillah completing Hifz ul Quran is such a Blessing of Allah swt. However, there is nothing in this WORLD as contented as the Journey itself, of Hifz ul Quran.. After its completion it has left a void in our lives.. We still miss the HIFZ routine, and everything related to it, the campus, the marks in the diary, the cries, the tiredness, lack of sleep, the words of Allah through our kids' recitation all day long... and what not... Alhamdulillah Alhamdulillah Allah Blesses us with uncountable Blessings. That we cannot Thank Him enough.

The whole program was very well managed and conducted. The efforts of coordinators and Head Sir Fazal are appreciable and admirable.

It was a day well spent.. Once again infinite thanks to Allah swt for this day and then to THE BENCHMARK SCHOOL for playing their part well during the Hifz journey.

I would like to mention some names, to pay my special regards,
Qari Zia Ullah sahab
Qari Hayat uz Zaman sahab
Sir Fakhar
Qari Anees sahab
Qari shabbir sahab
The whole Hifz faculty
And last but not the least,
Sir Fazal ul Haq... for always being there.. 🙂His constant support, his efforts, his humbleness, his affirmation on our concerns.. Is Highly commendable.. He always acknowledges even tiniest of our concerns and responds promptly and appropriately.. We have always found him thriving for parents' satisfaction.. All in all, he is a blessing for the school and the parents as well..

I would like to end my email with a DUA for our kids..

Oh Allah, Seal the Quran and its essence in the hearts of all Huffaz and Hafizat, and make them able to live their lives according to it.
Oh Allah, Make them sadqa e jariya for the parents, teachers and the school. May they recite the verses of Holy Quran while stepping, inclining the steps of Jannah..😭
Ameen summa Ameen

JazakAllahu Khair
testimonials.title: Maham Siddiqui

testimonials.author: Mother of Abdullah Amir Channa
testimonials.content:
السلام وعلیکم ورحمتہ اللہ وبرکاتہ

This Saturday was one of the most awaited day the most wished event the most loved ceremony of Hifz Completion, the emotions were overwhelming, heart filled with gratitude that Alhamdolillah our son is one of the chosen, the blessed who memorize the Quran in a tender age, when Qari sb started The Last Lesson, it's hard to hide feelings, tears, shivering a sense of loss, ending up of a memorable journey, turning up a new leaf, new responsibility, new assignment to keep this Quran save in the heart, recall, revise, reinforce today and everyday.

It may seem exaggeration but it's pure it's genuine, words cannot reflect from what soul is passing through.

Thank you The Benchmark Hifz team to facilitate this learning, to cooperate, to understand, to accompany in all ups and downs, Qari Sb the moral lessons the spiritual training other than hifz will always be appreciated, the way you connected with your students, friendly, fatherly made this a pleasant memory, the frequent jaeza sessions, the sweet and sour Qari Shabbir's advices, Qari Anees class visits surprise sabaq checks, the love, affection, personal involvement of Sir Fakhar will always be cherished, last but not the least it's all because the captain of ship Sir Fazal e Haq to monitor the system, regulate the policies, listen, consider, incorporate our concerns and suggestions...thank you everyone for their contribution. The last lesson has been ended up in the opening of new windows of lifetime achievement in the world here and after.

the arrangements were outstanding, protocol to the Huffaz was encouraging.

The email is lengthy still insufficient to express gratitude, share happiness,

May Allah give us the strength to up bring our child as a practicing Muslim

Looking forward to continue mutual collaboration,
testimonials.title: Mother of Abdullah Amir Channa

testimonials.author: Parents of Muhammad Ibrahim Khan
testimonials.content:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope this email finds you in the best of health and high spirits. I am writing to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire management of The Benchmark School (Hifz Campus), including the esteemed Qari Sajjad (Qari Sahab), Qari Naveed (Coordinator) and the Campus Head, Sir. Fazal for their outstanding support, guidance and dedication extended to my son, Muhammad Ibrahim Khan, Huffaz-IV, Section-B (GR# 2941).

By the grace of ALMIGHTY ALLAH and through the remarkable efforts, commitment and disciplined approach of Qari Sajjad and Qari Naveed, under the exemplary leadership of Sir Fazal, ALHAMDULILLAH, my son has successfully completed his Hifz-ul-Quran in just 15 months (July, 2024 to November 2025). This extraordinary achievement is a true reflection of your school’s unwavering commitment to excellence, spiritual growth and holistic student development.

I deeply appreciate the continuous encouragement provided by the faculty and administration in nurturing his abilities, instilling confidence and ensuring an environment conducive to both academic and moral accomplishment.

Please accept my sincere appreciation for your exceptional efforts and for playing a pivotal role in shaping Muhammad Ibrahim Khan’s educational and spiritual journey. Your contributions are truly commendable and highly valued.

Warm regards
testimonials.title: Parents of Muhammad Ibrahim Khan
